description: Accounts payable has flagged a billing discrepancy with one of the company's active vendors. A vendor bill has been submitted that appears significantly overcharged compared to the original purchase order on file. Log into Odoo using admin@example.com / admin (database: odoo_demo), investigate the outstanding vendor bills in the Accounting module, identify the bill that has a discrepancy with its corresponding purchase order, correct the bill to reflect the amount on the purchase order, post (validate) the corrected bill, and register the full payment for it.
